perspectives.name: The Heat
perspectives.purpose: Establish what physically changed: long-run warming, heat index, urban heat and duration/exposure.

perspectives.name: The Shift
perspectives.purpose: Follow heat into work: factory floors, construction/rickshaw work, health strain, breaks, productivity and missed days.

perspectives.name: The Pay Packet
perspectives.purpose: Follow lost work and reduced capacity into worker income, household budgets and the wider economy.

perspectives.name: The Home
perspectives.purpose: Follow heat beyond the workplace into recovery, housing and household exposure.

perspectives.name: The Next Generation
perspectives.purpose: Show how the same heat system reaches children through health risk and disrupted schooling without claiming every closure was caused only by heat.

perspectives.name: The Fix
perspectives.purpose: Follow adaptation: cooling, ventilation, building changes, workplace standards, finance and social protection; distinguish tested interventions from proposals.

output.aoc001_template_check: PASS — perspectives were derived from heat evidence and are not AOC-001's six-category taxonomy.
